_comment: Project fidelity config for SPX dialog master 463:3300. Same tolerances as buttons/cards. Icons are Feather glyphs (font-glyph not vector) so iconDeviations waives the per-icon vector-path identity check (geometry/box still validated).
_fontAliasNote: Figma master labels the CJK family 'HarmonyOS Sans TC'; app ships HarmonyOS Sans SC + PlusJakartaSans-* for Latin. These aliases keep the diff free of phantom font deviations.

iconDeviations.name: ^icon$
iconDeviations.reason: Outer 'icon' frame (36×36 round tinted bg) wraps each result-dialog tone icon. Impl renders the bg via View styles + a Feather glyph child — no <svg> on the bg frame itself. The named child icon (icon-check / Danger Triangle / Close Circle / Letter / Clock Circle) is separately waived; the bg frame's box/color is still validated by token diff.

iconDeviations.name: ^Outline / Essentional, UI / Danger Triangle$
iconDeviations.reason: Result-dialog 注册失败·邮箱已注册 icon is a Feather alert-triangle glyph (app-wide @expo/vector-icons system, see cards master deviation). Geometry/box still validated; only vector-path identity waived.

iconDeviations.name: ^Outline / Essentional, UI / Close Circle$
iconDeviations.reason: Result-dialog 操作失败 icon is Feather X glyph. Same reason as Danger Triangle.

iconDeviations.name: ^Outline / Messages, Conversation  /  Letter$
iconDeviations.reason: Result-dialog 验证邮件已发送 icon is Feather mail glyph. Same reason as Danger Triangle.

iconDeviations.name: ^Outline / Time / Clock Circle$
iconDeviations.reason: Result-dialog 登录已过期 icon is Feather clock glyph. Same reason as Danger Triangle.

iconDeviations.name: ^icon-check$
iconDeviations.reason: Result-dialog 密码重置成功/账户创建成功 success icon is Feather check glyph; geometry/box validated.

iconDeviations.name: ^Vector$
iconDeviations.reason: Inner SVG vector node of the Feather icon glyph — wrapped by the icon frame above which is already validated. Vector-path identity per-Feather glyph follows the icon system.

_iconDeviationsNote: All result-dialog tone icons use Feather glyphs (icon font) consistent with the app-wide icon system. icon-diff downgrades these from fail to waive — the icon frame's bg/size/color is still numerically checked by token diff.
